variants.prompt: Ava stands in a sun-drenched Stockholm park during golden hour, her vibrant blue eyes sparkling with joy as she throws a colorful frisbee to a playful golden retriever. Wearing a lightweight white sundress, her long blonde hair flows in the gentle breeze. A DSLR camera captures her carefree smile and the soft focus of the background trees, emphasizing her radiant beauty against the serene natural surroundings.
